title: Selection across block boundaries
roadmap_anchor: Q1 > Debt > Resolve the reader's text architecture
acceptance: A reader can select and highlight a passage spanning a paragraph break
The resulting highlight persists as one per block, preserving the existing (blockIndex, start, length) anchoring
notes: The accepted cost of T-0002's decision to keep one UITextView per block. Filed so the trade is visible rather than forgotten. Do not attempt before there is evidence readers actually hit it — a cross-block selection mechanism over N separate text views is genuinely hard, and the roadmap has more valuable work.

history.detail: cross-block selection; no evidence anyone hits it
